source_commit_resolution: Resolve v1.11.0^{commit} for the final main merge commit; annotated tag must point to that commit.
release_scope: Source publication; Ubuntu acceptance images built and verified, no production deployment.
tag_relation: Tracked runtime, tests, migrations, dependencies and build input hashes must match the tested commit; later commits only add release evidence.

rollback.runtime_effect: Source publication does not switch production. u22/t21 downgrade refuses populated alerts/actions/multiple events; restore verified pre-upgrade backup for a schema rollback. Keep current post-upgrade backup to preserve new event/action evidence.
